---
title: "Utilities for managing projects related to satellite remote sensing in rivers. "
output: github_document
---

I have designed this package for my own personal use to help with analysis 
related to research projects focused on analyzing and doing stats on spatial 
data from rivers, and connecting it to data derived from satellite remote 
sensing. Others are welcome to use it but I cannot garauntee that it will work 
for anyone else or that I will be able to respond to any questions or issues. 

It relies heavily on several awesome datasets built for river satellite remote 
sensing. They are: 

* [The Global River Widths from Landsat database](https://zenodo.org/records/1297434) (Allen and Pavelsky (2018) Global Extent of Rivers and Streams. Science. https://doi.org/10.1126/science.aat0636)  
* [The SWOT River Database (SWORD v17c)](https://zenodo.org/records/22259077) (Altenau, E. H., Pavelsky, T. M., Durand, M. T., Yang, X., Frasson, R. P. d. M., & Bendezu, L. (2021). The Surface Water and Ocean Topography (SWOT) Mission River Database (SWORD): A global river network for satellite data products. Water Resources Research, 57(7), e2021WR030054. https://doi.org/10.1029/2021WR030054)  

## Installation
```{r, eval = F}
remotes::install_github("helenmiller16/riverSatUtils")
```
